qualification: 6 MP RGBA32F, same initialized private input, frozen 039 controls, full AP1 output comparison. Texture accounting only.

accounting.rust039: Texture-pool budget high-water mark. The final output may be absent at the peak. Subtract the input, the actual final output and one measured positive heap estimate overshoot for a conservative lower bound.
accounting.scope: Engine accounting. Driver and command staging, pipeline memory, unrelated allocations and test readback are outside these figures. The 039 receipt accounts for textures; its validation flag and shader arguments are outside that budget.
accounting.wgpuMetal: Actual charge for the resident input and output textures and the graph parameter and validation buffers, with logical sizes as minimum charges. Subtract actual input and output allocations to obtain the intermediate charge.

nativePerformance.scope: host wall from prepareFinal invocation to its return
nativePerformance.throughputFormula: width * height * measuredSamples / sum(host wall seconds)
